title: Scent of a Woman Hotels: Where It Was Filmed
description: Two real New York hotels from Scent of a Woman: the Waldorf Astoria and The Pierre, home of the famous tango. See how to book both.
h1: Scent of a Woman hotels: where it was filmed
intro: Al Pacino's Oscar-winning 1992 film sends its characters through some of Manhattan's grandest hotels. Two of them are open today and can be booked.

hotels.note: The Waldorf-Astoria is where Frank Slade and Charlie stay during their New York weekend.
The film's tango scene was shot in the Pierre's Cotillion Ballroom.

outro: The two hotels are a short trip apart in Manhattan, the Waldorf on Park Avenue and the Pierre on Fifth Avenue by Central Park. Book one for the stay and visit the other for a drink.
